title: The Click Collapse: AI retrieval layers and the end of search discovery
description: The Click Collapse (#1091) forecasts continued organic decline through 2026 and 2027 and holds that neither litigation nor the platform's opt-out will restore the discovery pipeline or publisher revenue. It states four falsifiers: that the zero-click and CTR figures fail to replicate, that AI Overviews are neutral to organic CTR, that revenue does not track AI Overview appearance, and that classical SEO restores citation share.

claims.registered_title: The Click Collapse: How AI Retrieval Layers Replaced Search Discovery
claims.statement: Doing nothing means: continued organic decline at category-specific rates through 2026 and 2027; continued invisibility to the citation table; continued semantic drift on your own name at whatever rate the composition layer renders; and increasing lock-in to paid distribution channels whose ROI is compressing under the same summarizer pressure. There is no window in which the pre-2024 discovery pipeline returns.
